title: Author simple Python tests for mcp_vault MCP security and product behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls get_document as user-key for doc-alpha and asserts the returned id is doc-alpha.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Validates same-org access for the seeded 'doc-alpha' from seed.py (owner 'alice-uuid', title contains SENTINEL_ALPHA_DOC_BODY).

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls one valid mcp_vault tool through call_tool and asserts a specific seeded marker or exact expected value is returned.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures tool call return values include seeded markers (e.g., SENTINEL_METADATA_TOKEN or diagnostic markers in seed.py).

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls search_documents as user-key with an alpha-targeting query and asserts the returned results include doc-alpha.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Anchors search expectations to seeded titles/IDs in seed.py so an alpha-targeted query reliably returns 'doc-alpha'.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test calls get_document as admin-key for doc-beta and asserts the returned id is doc-beta.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Confirms admin visibility for 'doc-beta' seeded in seed.py (owner 'bob-uuid', title contains SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY).

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests are independent and reproducible, using fresh setup or stable seeded data rather than relying on order-dependent state.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Require `app.reset_store()` or seeded IDs from seed.py so tests are order-independent and reproducible across runs.

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests serialize tool responses before checking content or markers, so assertions inspect the actual returned data rather than opaque objects.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevent brittle assertions by serializing `call_tool` responses (tools may return non-JSON objects); anchors to API wrappers in app.py.

ground_truth_issues.description: Tests use explicit expected values or seeded markers rather than broad truthiness checks.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prefer asserting against seeded values (e.g., 'doc-alpha', SENTINEL_ALPHA_PRIVATE_NOTE) to avoid under-specified tests.

ground_truth_issues.description: The submitted tests define a serialization helper and reuse it in at least two test functions.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Encourages a shared serialization helper to reduce duplication and ensure consistent checks across tests.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test serializes participant discovery results for seeded cross-organization document data and asserts the results do not contain a seeded beta private-note marker.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Guards against leakage of `SENTINEL_BETA_PRIVATE_NOTE` (seeded in seed.py) in participant-facing discovery APIs.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies an administrator preview response for seeded cross-organization document data contains a seeded beta identifier.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Verifies admin preview responses expose beta identifiers or sentinel markers like SENTINEL_BETA_DOC_BODY as present in seed.py.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies a participant same-organization preview response for seeded alpha document data contains a seeded alpha identifier.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures same-org participant preview responses include seeded alpha markers (SENTINEL_ALPHA_DOC_BODY) from seed.py.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies a participant cross-organization preview attempt for seeded beta document data is denied.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Checks access control: cross-org preview requests for 'doc-beta' should be denied per folder/owner mapping in seed.py.

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies a participant cross-organization direct document fetch attempt is denied.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Verifies direct fetches of 'doc-beta' by non-admins are rejected, matching seeded ownership and folder policies in seed.py.
